name: Back Creek at Caldwell Rd near Harrisburg

impacts.statement: Major Flood Stage.  Extremely rare and catastrophic flooding is developing along Back Creek with disastrous impacts to property.  Extraordinary flooding exceeding 6 ft deep is overwhelming low-lying areas.  Basements and crawl spaces may be completely submerged.  First-floor building elevations may be experiencing ruinous flooding greater than 1 ft deep.  Travel may be severely restricted with roadway inundation exceeding 3-4 ft, stranding several homes and businesses.

Moderate Flood Stage.  Unusual, damaging flooding is developing adjacent to Back Creek with considerable impacts to property.  Significant flooding reaching 4-6 ft deep is ongoing for low-lying areas.  Secondary roads, outbuildings, crawl spaces, and/or basements may be experiencing flooding reaching 2-4 feet deep.  Flooding less than 1 ft deep may begin for first-floor building elevations.  Some homes and businesses may be stranded.  Significant impacts to travel are likely.
Minor flooding continues.  Back Creek is likely flooding Stallings Rd between Middleton Cir and Quail Hollow Dr, forcing road closure.

...continued from the 10.0 statement.  Adjacent secondary roads and outbuildings may be experiencing flooding up to 1-2 ft deep, including near Orchard Park Cir, Hickory Ridge Rd,  Blackjack Oak Ct, Stallings Rd, and Middleton Cir.  Flooding less than 1 ft deep may begin impacting basements and primary roads, including Stallings Rd between Middleton Cir and Quail Hollow Dr.

Minor Flood Stage.  Common, deeper flooding of low-lying areas adjacent to Back Creek is developing with lesser impacts to vulnerable property.  More significant floodwaters are beginning to impact low-lying areas, including the Back Creek Greenway, with inundation approximately 2-4 ft deep.  Impacts continued in the 10.01 statement...

Action/Advisory Stage flooding continues.  Extensive flooding of adjacent low-lying areas is developing, impacting the Back Creek Greenway and low-lying areas adjacent to Stallings Rd between Middleton Cir and Quail Hollow Dr.

Action/Advisory Stage.  Common, nuisance flooding of low-lying areas adjacent to Back Creek is beginning.  Floodwaters are beginning to impact farmland, woodlands, nurseries, parks, athletic fields, golf courses, and greenways with up to 2 feet of inundation.  Adjacent secondary roads may experience floodwater inundation of up to 1 foot.

value.label: North American Vertical Datum of 1988
value.description: A fixed reference for elevations determined by geodetic leveling. The datum was derived from a general adjustment of the first-order terrestrial leveling nets of the United States, Canada, and Mexico. In the adjustment, only the height of the primary tidal bench mark, referenced to the International Great Lakes Datum of 1985 (IGLD 85) local mean sea level height value, at Father Point, Rimouski, Quebec, Canada was held fixed, thus providing minimum constraint. NAVD 88 and IGLD 85 are identical. However, NAVD 88 bench mark values are given in Helmert orthometric height units while IGLD 85 values are in dynamic heights. See International Great Lakes Datum of 1985, National Geodetic Vertical Datum of 1929, and geopotential difference. NAVD 88 should not be used as Mean Sea Level.

forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
